findings.evidence: CofinalIdeal/Basic.lean:208 (`CofinalValueFor.lt_one`, arbitrary `H`), :239 (`cofinalValueFor_top_iff : CofinalValueFor v ⊤ a ↔ CofinalValue v a`), :9 (`public import TauCeti.RingTheory.Valuation.CharacteristicGroup`). The same route is already used at :253 (`not_cofinalValueFor_one` calls `h.lt_one`).
findings.fix: Rewrite as: `CofinalValueFor.lt_one` does imply this via `cofinalValueFor_top_iff`, but it lives downstream in `CofinalIdeal/Basic.lean`, so the `⊤` case is proved directly here; conversely the `⊤` hypothesis is the strongest of the family, so this one does not supply the general form.
findings.issue: The docstring says `CofinalValueFor.lt_one` "is the more general statement, so it cannot supply this one here" — backwards. Being more general is exactly why it does supply it: `cofinalValueFor_top_iff.mpr h |>.lt_one` proves this lemma. The real obstruction is module order: both live in `CofinalIdeal/Basic.lean`, which imports `CharacteristicGroup.lean`.

findings.evidence: Line 129 area: `hemb : ValueGroup₀.embedding γ = v r / v t`, obtained from `v.exists_div_eq_of_unit` (mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Valuation/Basic.lean:545: `v.restrict r / v.restrict s = γ.1`), and the ball is opened by `hv.isOpen_lt_div r ht.ne'`, i.e. `{a | v a < v r / v t}`.
findings.fix: Write `v r / v t` in both places (or rename the proof's witnesses).
findings.issue: The module docstring (line 32) and the docstring of `cofinalValue_of_isTopologicallyNilpotent` (line 114) both say a general `γ ∈ Γ_v` is the ratio `v t / v r`, using the same letters as the proof — where the relation is the reciprocal, `γ = v r / v t`.

summary: Documentation coverage is complete and the hypothesis-weakening docstring updates are accurate, but two docstrings state facts that do not hold: the rationale attached to `CofinalValue.lt_one` gives a backwards reason for why the general lemma cannot be reused, and the new file describes the value-group ratio in the reciprocal order to its own proof.
